abstract: Laparoscopic removal is widely accepted as the treatment of choice for dermoid tumors. However, the spillage of dermoid content with the laparoscopic approach is very high compared to laparotomy. The potential malignancy of dermoid tumors and the rare, but difficult to treat, chemical peritonitis in cases of spillage of dermoid content should lead to an adaptation of procedures during an endoscopic operation on a dermoid tumor to comply with the precautions of the "open" technique. Lift-laparoscopy combines laparoscopy with the standard procedures of laparotomy and thus may help reduce the spillage of dermoid contents. In a retrospective study of 108 patients with dermoid tumors, the frequency of the rupture of a dermoid tumor during a lift-laparoscopic operation was examined. Among the 79 cases of organ-preserving treatment, there were only three cases (3.8%) where a rupture of the dermoid capsule occurred. Even in cases of ruptures, it was possible to avoid spillage by closing the lesion with a clamp and continue the enucleation of the dermoid tumor during a lift-laparascopic operation. After thorough abdominal cavity lavage, none of these three cases showed a cytological contamination of the abdominal cavity with dermoid cells. None of the ovariectomy or adnexectomy cases showed a rupture. Histologically, there was also no carcinoma in any of the examined dermoid tumors. By adapting the endoscopic dermoid surgery to the precautions established in an open surgery technique using gasless lift-laparoscopy, ruptures and cell spilling can be avoided to a large extent but not completely excluded. Compared with other methods, the number of ruptures and spillage of dermoids by organ-preserving treatment as well as ovariectomy is lowest using a lift-laparoscopic procedure.
abstract_ja: 皮様嚢腫に対する腹腔鏡手術は治療の第一選択として広く受け入れられている。しかし、腹腔鏡手術では皮様嚢腫内容物の漏出が開腹手術に比べて非常に多い。皮様嚢腫の悪性化の可能性や、内容物漏出時に起こる化学性腹膜炎は、まれではあるが治療が困難であり、内視鏡手術では開腹手術の注意点に準拠した手技を用いるべきである。リフト腹腔鏡は腹腔鏡と開腹手術の標準手技を組み合わせたもので、内容物の漏出低減に役立つ可能性がある。皮様嚢腫108例の後方視的研究において、リフト腹腔鏡手術中の皮様嚢腫破裂頻度を検討した。臓器温存治療を受けた79例のうち、皮様嚢腫被膜の破裂は3例(3.8%)のみであった。破裂が生じた場合でも、クリップで病変を閉鎖し、摘出を続行することで漏出を回避できた。3例すべてで十分な腹腔洗浄の後、腹腔内に皮様細胞による細胞学的汚染は認められなかった。卵巣摘出術または付属器摘出術を受けた症例では、破裂は認められなかった。組織学的には、検討した皮様嚢腫のいずれにも癌腫は認められなかった。開腹手術の注意点に準拠した内視鏡的皮様嚢腫手術をガスレスリフト腹腔鏡で行うことで、破裂と細胞漏出の多くを回避できるが、完全に排除することはできない。他の方法と比較すると、リフト腹腔鏡による臓器温存治療および卵巣摘出術では、破裂と内容物漏出の件数が最も少ない。
